name: build_sru_search_url: has a description
got:
Turn an erratum/correction notice title (e.g. 'Correction: <title>', 'Correction to “<title>”',
    'Corrigendum: ...') into the NAL Alma production SRU searchRetrieve URL for the original article.

name: build_sru_search_url: input schema is an object; required fields are declared properties
got: {"required": ["correction_title"], "properties": ["correction_title"]}

name: build_sru_search_url: annotated read-only and non-destructive
got: {"title": "Build NAL Alma SRU search URL", "read_only_hint": true, "destructive_hint": false, "idempotent_hint": true, "open_world_hint": false}
